name: Karandeep
text: We had an absolute blast staying at Craig’s cabin. The place is just 5 minutes walk to the coffee places, alpine zoo and 5 minutes drive to the Village. Hosts are very responsive and immediately addressed any questions we had. The place was extremely clean and felt so homely. We recommend this stay. Thank you for hosting us.

name: Andrea
text: great house, really cute, loved the bay window in the living area, gave it extra light and lots of windows to open to get the fresh air. loved that there was 2 full bathrooms, one downstairs and one up., Nice patio area with a firepit and bbq, we used both, neighborhood super quite. lots of birds to look at too. it was really nice to have a living space with a nice big couch, kitchen was great, with nice appliances.  Its a nice cozy house, felt right at home, definately  would stay here again!

name: Tina
text: We love the place! Super clean & cozy, offering everything we need for our trip. Full-function kitchen and backyard with BBQ grill. We enjoyed having breakfast & dinner at the sun-bathed backyard during our stay, surrounded by trees & fresh air. Great for family. I highly recommend this place!

name: Arlet
text: My family and I had the best time! The home felt very cozy and we liked how the space felt private. Our favorite part was having breakfast in the patio out back and just enjoying nature. The only thing I would say is that the dryers took a couple cycles to fully dry the clothes so just make sure to account enough time for that. Cozy place, highly recommend!

name: Brandon
text: This is our second time staying at this wonderful home! the hosts are always so helpful, and have wonderful communication. The house is located in a beautiful area and within walking distance to the zoo, and a quick drive to pine knot Ave. The house is stocked with pretty much everything you could possibly need!

name: Dalia
text: We really enjoyed our stay with our family of 5. We loved the fact that we were able to be close to the stores. The area is nice and quiet with a BBQ area that our family enjoyed the evenings talking, listening to the birds, and listening to the wind rustling the tree leaves. The host kept in constant contact with us to make sure that everything was running smoothly. It was a very de-stressing experience for us and we look forward  staying there again in the future.

name: Tom
text: The photos do not do this home justice. We were pleasantly surprised when we checked-in. Very comfortable and we truly felt right at home. Everything was clean and well appointed. We will be frequenting Big Bear on business for the next 9 months, so hopefully we will be able to stay again.

name: Irina
text: Cosy little cabin on the outside and quite spacious on the inside! The host is very responsive and cares a lot about your comfort. The deck was a pleasure to spend time at!

name: Amy
text: Moonridge is a great neighborhood to stay in. Close to everything, safe and nice. The home itself was nice. The bottom floor is updated, nice large kitchen and comfortable large livingroom. The upstairs is nice. The king bed was extremely soft, too much for my husband and I. We switched rooms with the kids and slept in the firmer queen beds and it was great. All the pillows are feather and not firm, so if you want firm, bring your own pillow. I appreciated the throw blankets to keep us warm! The only thing we didn't love was some of the nonstick pans are chipping so we didn't use those. But the stainless steel pans, everything stuck to them :/ Also a lot of the spices were out or not there. Wish I had checked and purchased those when we went shopping. But that's on us, not the place.

name: Joe
text: We loved our stay here, and we would be happy to stay here again. However, if I went back, it would be helpful to know a few things before going. These are things I wish I would have known before we went. 1. The cabinets are very high, and there is no stool to try to reach the shelves. I had to stand on one of the chairs a couple of times, and I would normally never stand on anyone else's chairs! So, if I went back, I would take a stool. 2. The room with the king sized bed is not a master bedroom with a bathroom. The master bedroom with the bathroom is the room with the two queens. So, our kids got a bathroom right off their room, but my husband and I were going up and down the stairs to use the bathroom. 3. The cushions for the patio chairs are super thin and worn out. I would have to do a double cushion to make a seat remotely comfortable. I really loved sitting out there on the deck with a book once the sun went down in the early evening though, and it was such lovely weather!

name: Alexandra
text: We had a wonderful stay at Craig's place. We made use of the fireplace every night to keep us cozy and loved that they had a Christmas tree setup. It really felt like a Christmas getaway. The beds were super comfy and everything was very clean and it felt spacious. We will definitely be re-booking this Airbnb next winter. Thank you Craig for a wonderful stay.

name: Elizabeth
text: This was such a cute place. It felt cozy and right at home. It’s not far from the village and stores were all close by. Short ride. We really enjoyed our stay. My kids did not want to leave. We knew there was no TVs in the other room so we set up our kids tablets in there for them to watch. We would definitely stay here again.

name: Paul
text: This was an awesome place to stay! We had an amazing time and loved the location! The patio is one of the great parts of the location

name: Doug
text: Great easy place to stay- Craig was very helpful throughout the stay. Would stay again.

name: Blanca
text: was a great time the house is in a great area peaceful and quiet but still close by to all the fun

name: Cindy
text: My family and I really enjoyed staying at this home. Everything was exactly as described, if not better! Craig made us feel very welcomed. Will definitely be booking again in the future.

name: GiaBao
text: We had a wonderful stay. The house is clean and nicely decorated. Living  room is spacious, kitchen well-equipped and bedrooms cozy. Close to Bear Mountain and closer to Snow Summit. Hosts kept in regular contact, as needed. Definitely recommend and will stay again!

name: Xenia
text: Very convenient location for skiing! The cottage is well stocked with supplies for those who are staying longer. check in was very easy and Craig is very good at communicating!

name: Adriana
text: we loved this Beautiful home. Our experience was great.We didn't have any issues. Kitchen was perfect I felt just like I was at home cooking I'll thank you to craig and mercedes for being so helpful, kind And responsive. I'll be booking here again!

name: Ksenia
text: Craig is a fantastic host—very responsive and attentive to small details that make a stay special, like providing quality coffee, a tea and coffee maker, updated kitchen equipment, extra wood for the fireplace, and a beautiful Christmas tree for the holidays. The house was cozy, with plenty of space for our family of four to relax, and had everything we needed for an enjoyable stay. The location is great, quiet neighborhood with the Summit just a short drive away and hiking trails practically at the door. We will definitely be back!

name: Armen
text: By far, the BEST AirBnB property I’ve ever been in. It was exactly what I expected! Everything was super organized, it was cozy, and it really felt like we were right at home. Zero complaints!!!

name: Jackie
text: This home is so beautiful and cozy. It’s located in a great spot near by everything stores, restaurants and attractions. Easy to find and very responsive host. Would definitely stay here again!

name: Hyeseung
text: Very cozy, beautiful place. We had great time.

name: Rita
text: The place was adorable and just the right size and location for our getaway . . . and the front yard was perfect for our two year old granddaughter to play in the snow! Jeannine La Mesa, California Rating, 5 stars , · March 2025 , · Stayed with kids This place was a gem! It was perfect for my 30th birthday with my family and I’m so grateful we were able to stay here at a great price with our littles!

name: Regat
text: Great location, close to mostly everything such as the lake, the zoo, and stores. Very peaceful and cozy place. Made us feel like we’re at home:)

name: Christina
text: Overall a great experience in a beautiful home. Our hosts were amazing and answered all of our questions very quickly. We can't wait to come back.

name: Candice
text: Nice little cabin in a great location!

name: Richard
text: A great stay! Thank you again!

name: Jeannette
text: Comfy stay just as pictured would stay again!

name: Zane
text: Very nice stay with great amenities. Host communication was spot on. Loved our stay.

name: Johannes
text: Down the street from snow summit. Kind hosts and a neat place. Will stay again.

name: Anthony
text: Beautiful home, great location, comfortable beds would love to rent again in the future

name: Ismael
text: We had an exceptional stay at Craig’s place. From the moment we arrived, they were welcoming and attentive, ensuring everything was perfect and always had a quick response to my questions. The accommodation was clean, well-equipped, and exactly as described. I highly recommend their place to anyone looking for a hassle-free and enjoyable stay. Thank you, Craig for making my trip so memorable! 🙂

name: Ty
text: We really enjoyed our stay at Craig’s place. We’ve rented numerous cabins in Big Bear and this place is the best! Super clean all around! Comfortable beds and furniture! The patio is great for morning reading/coffee and dinner bbq! Host super responsive! No complaints. We will be back. Thank you for sharing your cabin!

name: Trevor
text: The hosts were very welcoming and everything in showed pictures were 100% working and everything was well in order. They gave us local events that were going on in the area and allowed us to use all amenities that were in the house. It was very clean and well organized. It was a blast staying at the place and would definitely try and book it in the future.

name: Brandon
text: This home was absolutely beautiful! This was our first family trip with our son, the home was pristine. Everything was exactly like the photos, beautifully located area, stocked well, and felt very clean. The host was very accommodating and checked in to see if we needed any help. Would 100% recommend to anyone looking for a lovely relaxing stay, and would love to book again!

name: Manny
text: This was the perfect cabin at an amazing price. The host was very communicative from the moment I booked until I checked out of the cabin. The cabin was clean and looked exactly like the photos, it’s also a plus that the location is within minutes of restaurants, nearby shops and walking distance to the big bear zoo. Overall a great experience, looking forward to booking this cabin again soon. Thanks Craig 👌🏽

name: Chris
text: Craigs cabin was the perfect stay for a Big Beat get away. It was super coast for a snow day and a beautiful neighborhood. Super close to shops, lake, and the Village. Craig is a super host and would respond immediately to any questions I had. I highly recommend Craigs cabin. Can’t wait to be back in the near future. Thank you Craig!

name: Sarah
text: This cabin was just what we were looking for when we decided to book a couple days up in Big Bear last minute! It was close to both Bear Mountain Resort and not far from the downtown area. The cabin was cozy, clean and the hosts were great! The beds were a little too soft for our liking, but other than that I can only say good things! I would definitely recommend this cabin to anyone looking to enjoy their stay up in Big Bear!

name: Kenneth
text: We loved the property! Everything is literally and conveniently close by. Snow Summit, Big Bear Mountain Resort, grocery stores, Starbucks all less than 5 minutes away. Craig was very fast to respond to questions and it made the entire stay smooth. Comfortable bed and couch, warm rooms, patio was great. Very cozy vibe! We loved every second we were there. Thank you Craig!

name: Diego
text: Me and my friends were looking for some peaceful place to stay along from the city stress and this was the best option, we have a great weekend with my friends in a really beautiful, cozy and relaxed house. I really appreciate the great communication and the clear instructions from the host. I really recommend this house!

name: D
text: The cutest little home in the woods. The owners have thought of everything. Down to plugs for your phone by the bed, nightlights, lights if the power goes out. Great instructions for fireplace. Clean and comfy. All that you could ask for. And they checked on us. Checking in at doormat was a breeze. Easy 10 out of 10 place. We will be back for sure.

name: Horst
text: We had a very nice time at the Moonlight Deck and would definitely book it again next time. The description of the house is very accurate, our expectations were fully met. Thanks for the nice friendly communication. Horst

name: Kristen
text: Great location, super close to Bear Mountain

name: Susie
text: Great stay and great communication

name: Victoria
text: A warm, well-appointed cabin in a great location.

name: Stephen
text: This house was very nice.  It was exactly as described and as seen in the pictures.  Very comfortable and in a great neighborhood.  Would definitely recommend this house and plan to return.

name: Sandra
text: Spent 5 days and nights at this wonderful place.  Just what I needed to relax from the hustle and bustle of Los Angeles. My 75+ year old parents were able to maneuver the house  without additional assistance. Highly recommend for those who want to RELAX. Most locations are within 20 mins at most from the house. Thank you for allowing us to stay at your home❣️

name: Adrian
text: We decided on a last minute vacation and chose this wonderful cabin because the quite location and spacious living room the couch was a big plus. Kitchen was great and nicely updated bedrooms were great

name: Vanessa
text: Craig was wonderful and very responsive. Their place had everything we needed for our stay and the layout of the house was perfect! The location was also great. We really enjoyed our stay.

name: Melissa
text: The house was everything we expected and had everything we needed. it was in a great location very clean and accommodating. The only issue was we couldn’t get the heat warm enough even with support from the owners. Only a problem because we had the babies with us.

name: Taylor
text: 10 out of 10 experience. Super cozy, clean, large bedrooms, amazing kitchen/appliances, and literally 5 minute walk to the shuttle for the mountain. Craig was wonderful. Cant wait to be back!!

name: Stephanie
text: Craig is a 5-star hose - super responsive and helpful - which makes our stay a great experience! And the location is very convenient - easy to get to the slopes, the grocery store, the lake, etc.

name: Trisha
text: Great host and great location! Check in and check out was easy! Craig was responsive throughout our stay. We couldn’t have asked for a better location! It was close to everything we needed! The beds were comfy and the washer/Dryer was a great bonus!

name: Todd
text: We had a wonderful time. Great place to get away for a few nights for some relaxation. Full of amenities and centrally located. We would definitely stay again and recommend to others.

name: Brittney
text: Craig was a wonderful host! Great location for skiing and close to downtown. Very clean, great kitchen,if plan on cooking, ( with grill outside) and nice cozy family room to relax in after a day of skiing!

name: Jalen
text: The place was very clean and up to date! Host were very responsive and friendly, perfect for a nice getaway or family. Couches were very comfy and felt like home. Would definitely recommend this home!

name: Zyanya
text: The place is exactly as in the photos, it is clean, tidy and very equipped with everything necessary for the stay. Craig is a splendid host, we would definitely return to this accommodation.

name: Jessica
text: This is a lovely home that is close to EVERYTHING! Great location, we had 2 minor complaints that I brought up to Craig and he handled it with great hospitality and care. Thank you for a wonderful experience, we will definitely book your home for future stays.

name: Joe
text: this is one of the best airbnb we stayed in big bear. The location is very convenient close to both snow summit and bear mountain. the house is very clean and just feel at home, beyond expectation. we will definitely come back again

name: Gilbert
text: Went up for the weekend with the Family had an Amazing Experience Craig was very accommodating and met all of our families needs.   We would definitely come back and stay another weekend!

name: Ashley
text: Amazing! Thank you

name: Lore
text: Everything was excellent, very good location, very good service from the hosts, the cabin is very nice, very well equipped in the kitchen, terrace, nice, very comfortable beds

name: Aneri
text: This airbnb was in a great location and it was convenient to check out the village and still be able to come back in between plans/reservations. Check in was quite easy. The TV was broken but I was aware of this prior, as i read other guest reviews, and Craig shared that it won't be fixed by my reservation. The issue I had was that we had to buy our own toilet paper and gallons of water as the 'order filter' sign was present. Unfortunately; Craig was not accomodating to this inconvenience. There was also food left in the freezer and some hair on the beds, allowing me to believe it was not thoroughly cleaned prior to our arrival. Overall, hosts were responsive for the most part and it was a decent stay.

name: Edward
text: What an amazing getaway! Craig’s property is wonderful, boasts all the amenities one needs and is just tucked away enough that you feel like you’ve been away from the hustle and bustle of the city. As a Los Angeles native I’ve seldom come to Big Bear opting for inns and hotels; however, after staying here, there is so much more value incurred from this stay. You have your own kitchen, fireplace, grill, and bedroom to make yourself feel right at home. Craig is responsive and I never felt out of my element. I hope you all come visit this Air Bnb and I cannot wait to be back with my family.

name: Tina
text: Right from the start, we had that “Home Away from Home”feeling. The location is perfect for anything you want to do in the area. It’s a great neighborhood with neighbors walking dogs who welcome AirBnB guests with conversation and tips for local restaurants etc…Super good vibe…The beds are snuggle comfy after long days on the slopes! Seating in main area is comfortable and roomy. The house is clean and smells divine. Kitchen offered great opportunities for us to cook our signature family recipes and spend quality evenings together. Washer/Dryer GREAT PLUS. Our #BigBearFamJam was perfect thanks to our choosing this home. Thank you Craig for the memories 😊

name: Peter
text: This is a great place with very friendly and responsive hosts. Would love to stay here again.

name: Clara
text: Thanks for having us! The area is quiet and a good location close to everything. The place was clean.

name: Tricia
text: There was a couple things when we got to the home and noticed that after walking through checking the place out one of the cabinets, lower cabinets in the kitchen, the door hinge was broken, and not attached to the fixture, which, of course was not a problem (my husband is a carpenter and tried to fix it with little to no tools) and then another thing was the main Living Room TV is sort of like broken with lines going across the screen, but you could still see a picture so we were still able to watch TV. Other than that, everything was great! Place was clean (except for under the furniture) and the home is cozy. Not used to separate kitchen and living room concept but it works regardless. Kitchen was equipped with everything you can think of. More than enough room for my ‘ohana or 5. Craig was very responsive and answered all the questions I had thrown at them. They also kept in touch making sure we were ok and seeing if everything was to our liking. I would definitely stay

name: Candice
text: The house was perfect for our needs, and Craig was friendly and responsive. We had a great time, and would stay again!

name: Kyle
text: Craig’s place is absolutely wonderful, and easily the best spot I’ve stayed in Big Bear!  First of all, I love that it’s owned and managed by actual people, not a management company as so much of Big Bear is. AirBnB to me has always been about quality hosts which Craig clearly is. You can tell they keep this home in fantastic shape as everything is clean and in great condition. Nothing feels “dated” or “worn out” which can be the case sometimes. The kitchen is completely stocked with cookware (we made cookies!) and quality appliances. The master bedroom is super cozy and comfortable… and while we did not sleep in the other bedroom it looked great, too! Both bathrooms were spotless and the shower was hot with great pressure. Perfect location for skiing and the wonder Big Bear Zoo is walking distance. Close to Starbucks and both grocery stores. This will be where my family and I stay every time we come up if it’s available. 5 Stars across the board!

name: Tamara
text: I stayed at Craig’s cabin for a quick ski weekend with my girlfriends. Craig communicated with us from the start of our day to make sure we had all the instructions we needed to check in. The cabin was easy to find and in a beautiful location right by Snow Summit. The home was spotless upon arrival and smelled amazing. You could tell it was thoroughly cleaned before we arrived which made us all feel very comfortable settling in. The heater kicked on upon arrival as Craig had mentioned. The beds were some of the most comfortable I’ve slept in when staying in an airbnb. The home had all the resources and amenities we needed. The kitchen was fully stocked, allowing us to cook full and hearty meals throughout our stay. We didn’t run into a single issue staying here and would love to come back for our next big bear trip! Seriously a 10/10 experience!

name: Young
text: awesome place, clean, well-furnished and well-decorated.  Will certainly save place and stay again.

name: Billy
text: Perfect place to stay! Close to skiing, grocery stores, restaurants.  Great experience.  The hosts were very communicative and responsive!  Definitely recommend!

name: Sierra
text: This home is clean, comfortable, and quiet. We arrived in the evening around 9 & the house was 49°. Everyone was very cold and our baby was having a hard time getting warm. It took us about an hour+ to hear the heater actually kick on and then about 2 hours for the upstairs to warm up.  The downstairs stayed somewhat chilly, but it is winter, so layers were needed. Other than that, it was a nice stay. Plenty of appliances for your kitchen needs, comfortable beds (could use some better pillows or bring your own, they are a bit flat). Great sized couch for everyone to relax and a great backyard space. It was covered in snow, but I could tell fantastic for relaxing. Something to note is the upstairs bathroom is in the room with two beds, not the king bedroom. We would still stay again given the cleanliness, and quietness of the neighborhood.

name: Song Hee
text: It is easy, accurate and fast to contact the host. All new kitchen appliances. We had a memorable family trip. Thank you.

name: Ashley
text: Stayed here for 1 night and it was great. It was near everything and such a beautiful home. Craig was also very responsive.

name: Frank
text: Beautiful and cute cabin. Walkable distance to Bear mountain. Kitchen looks better than the photos. I would stay here again.

name: Richard
text: First of all i want to say thank you Craig, such great host!!! This place was just perfect for me and my family. Especially having little ones with us. We felt right at home and it’s hard to go to someone else’s home and feel so comfortable. Craig was awesome. He would respond asap with any questions we had and made sure everything was going well with us. It hard sometimes dealing with an airBNB when it’s ran by a third party company and feels more like a business , which I get it is  . But dealing with an owner who cares not only for their property and keeping things up to date in their home. But making sure people coming into their home feels welcomed, This is the  place . Would love too give them 10 stars ⭐️ if I could. We will most definitely come back here for future family trips. Thanks again !!!!!

name: Kayla
text: Wow! We had a short visit to Big Bear, and Craig's place was perfect. Very clean and short drive to the main road. Great spot and will visit again!

name: Blaise
text: This was a great cabin to spend the weekend in. Clean, spacious, well heated, and the hosts quickly responded to everything.

name: Abeer
text: Beautiful location and incredibly peaceful for my family and I to stay in. We left satisfied and well rested as well.

name: Tracye
text: Good location, plenty of room but the place needs a deep clean and some maintenance.

name: Reggie
text: Great hosts. Great home. No issues. I would stay there again.

name: Anna
text: The house, the host, the location was everything we expected and more.

name: Juanfra
text: Excellent communication, very comfortable cabin with all the amenities, I would definitely come back.

name: Alba
text: The location is very good , the only thing I didn't like is having to take the garbage in my own car to another location.

name: Ana
text: This place was just what we were looking for. With a toddler we had a backyard and quiet road. The beds and couch are comfy and you get a very clean feeling when you walk in. We were able to walk to the zoo, bus stop and coffee shop. Don’t forget condiments and foil paper because the refrigerator is actually clean!! Great communication and quick answers. Wi-Fi is work from home friendly!

name: Vukadin
text: The house is in a very good location, very clean and cosy. Perfect for family vacation , very peacefull and quiet neighbourhood. Rooms are very comfortable with an amazing view of the forest. The kitchen is big and well equipment. Bathrooms are very good also. On the back side of the house is wonderfull porch with sitting and dining area. Very easy for check in and out, amazing hosts and very polite with many fisihing tips and advices.

name: Jesus
text: I really enjoyed my stay, the house had it all and it easily made my friends and I feel right at home. We grilled some burgers and enjoyed the large outside area while enjoying the evening breeze. No complaints, the host are amazing to work with as they respond within minutes and resolve any issues at hand.

name: Suzi
text: We had a wonderful time at Craig's place. It had newer upgraded appliances and was very clean. The beds were very comfortable. It had a nice sitting area on the back deck that included a gas fireplace. It was very close to town and the lake. Craig checked on us to make sure everything was ok and was very quick to respond to any questions I had. Checking out was very easy. We will definitely stay here again!

name: Peter
text: Craig's property was perfect for our weekend trip! The property was in perfect condition and extremely well maintained (very clean!). It is located in a perfect area close to the market, zoo, big bear village, and big bear mountain resort. Communication was excellent and prompt. Every detail about the stay is well documented with clear instructions provided. I highly recommend booking this property for a vacation in big bear!

name: Andrea
text: This was a wonderful stay for my group! We had one couple and a child and there was plenty of space for us to have our own space but also gather in the living room. The location of the house was 5-10 minutes from the village and snow summit, in addition to anything else you may need (grocery store, Walgreens, etc.) Will definitely look to stay here again!

name: Connor
text: Craig was super helpful and responsive as we got to big bear to check-in and throughout the stay. The home was super nice for a quick get away from the city. Little things that you don’t expect from an Airbnb, like quality shower toiletries and spices in the kitchen for cooking, don’t go unnoticed and make the stay feel more like a home away from home. Would stay here again. Thanks for everything!

name: Olga
text: My family and I spent a lovely weekend at Craig's place. The cabin is lovely and stocked with everything you might need. We enjoyed our time on the back deck by the fire and would recommend this place to families with children. Craig was always online in case we had questions.

name: Claudia
text: We really like this home. It felt like home away from home. My family and I really liked how comfortable the beds were. The Zoo was extremely close also. We went to walk around the neighborhood and noticed it was walking distance. The host were very quick and answering our questions. Will definitely come back.

name: Erik
text: Excellent place, the service was spectacular. Of course we'll be back.

name: Ha Young
text: Cozy, simple home with an amazing view and peaceful.

name: Anthony
text: Rad location and cute lil spot. Had a wonderful time.

name: Oscar
text: Beautiful house, awesome hosts!

name: Terry
text: Highly recommend. House was very comfortable and equipped with all the comforts of home. Living room was cozy and plenty big with easy to use TV (only 1 remote😂) Enjoyed bbq’ing on the patio and relaxing outdoors. Walking distance to nice hiking trails in a very peaceful neighborhood. Bedrooms were a good size and bathrooms set up well.  We will be back, our 1st grandchild is due in October so we will be planning some extended stays in Big Bear in the near future. ❤️ Great communication with hosts!

name: Theresa
text: We had a nice stay overall and this place would be great for families. The outdoor space with the grill and fire pit was enjoyable. The bed at the primary bedroom was a bit too soft for our taste but otherwise the room with its views were lovely.

name: Austin
text: A Very Best of Big Bear !!!!   The Home is as Marvelous as described and has both a completely cozy atmosphere, while still being a multi-room large place to stay: the House is also very accessible to Main Attractions of Big Bear Lake !!!!

name: Ronnie
text: This place is fantastic. Home was neat and clean and had great decor. Home felt modern and had great amenities. Loved how many fans were available. Sitting on the deck for dinner was great. I would definitely book this place again! Alexander Fullerton, California Rating, 5 stars , · July 2023 , · Group trip Highly recommend this place for a weekend getaway with the family right from the beginning you feel right at home Craig did an outstanding job with this home and the way they treat us made us feel like family

name: Eric
text: Craig's house is absolutely lovely, well decorated and equipped. We felt at home instantly. The place is very quiet and well located, at 10 min from shops and restaurants. They are also super reactive and the communication was smooth. I recommend !

name: Andrew
text: The hospitality was great. The place was perfect for our family and a weekend trip. Private and peaceful. Washer was odd to use but other than that, everything else was great!

name: Shannon
text: House was really nice other than the missing blind segments.   The wifi temperature war we had with the host was interesting.  We would set it to a temp we wanted and it continued to change......the bed was hard for me but my husband loved it.  It was nice having a coffee pot other than a keurig.....not our thing.  But...the coffee ended up all over the counter....thank God we always bring our own for a back up.  Other than that....all the neighbors were friendly and waved to us.  And the house was pretty clean...

name: Jillian
text: Craig was a wonderful host. They were very quick to respond and fast to action with any requests. Their home was very clean, cozy, and great location! Definitely recommend staying here!

name: Neimann
text: The hosts were really responsive and helpful. Had no issues regarding the place and it is exactly as shown in the pictures. The amenities worked great and location was peaceful. Check in and checkout instructions were clearly communicated which made it hassle free

name: Yvette
text: The home was spacious but could have use deep cleaning of baseboards, touch up painting especially in the kitchen by Tarascan. Downstairs bathroom shower head needs work. Fireplace had fire stains. Lighting in kitchen could have been better.

name: Tina
text: We felt right at home from the moment we walked through the front door! Entry was effortless. Just the right amount of space for the 4 of us. Lots of natural light and super cozy couch. The beds were divine. I felt like I was floating on a cloud, the sheets were super soft! The location was perfect, so close to the ski resorts and the village. We really enjoyed the wood burning fireplace too. The perfect mountain getaway! Craig Thank you for sharing your lovely home!

name: Vanessa
text: Craig was a wonderful host. Appreciated the check ins and reminders. The house was perfect for my family of 6. We felt comfy and cozy and the kids enjoyed the backyard play. Would definitely recommend booking this place. Absolutely enjoyed our stay and felt welcome.

name: Heddol
text: What an experience! We stayed during Snowpocalypse, the biggest snowstorm of recent years. Even though our stay was somewhat stressful and concerning, with a child and an elderly parent, Craig was incredibly helpful during our trip. He always stayed in touch and offered every assistance possible. What a fantastic host. Thank you. Craig’s place was exactly as described, with so many wonderful touches to make you feel like home. We were very comfortable and this was by far the best Airbnb place I have ever booked. We will most definitely be back, and I would recommend Craig’s to anyone.

name: Brandee
text: I recommend staying here. Great value. It was a clean, comfortable, and peaceful stay for our family of four. The neighborhood is convenient to the Village and resorts, and it is quiet. The kitchen is clean and well-stocked. The beds and pillows are comfortable. There is plenty of space (apres ski yoga for two), and lots of seating upstairs and downstairs. The heat worked well and there were lots extra blankets if you wanted to be cozy. The hosts were proactive and friendly, and responded quickly when we had a request for help with snow and ice. We will look here for our next visit.

name: Mildred
text: Absolutely loved our stay! Craig was a great host that responded fast if and when needed. The cabin was so cute and is in such a great area, perfect for a little getaway!

name: Daniel
text: This was a great stay for me and my two adult daughters for a 3 day ski trip.  They had their own room with their own beds and a bathroom.  The other end of the hall I had a room all to myself!  Nicely furnished and clean.  Heating unit works great at the preset temperatures.  ROKU TV allowed us to relax after a day of skiing and fall asleep on the sectional. About a 5-7 minute car ride to Snow Summit.  Stay on the main roads though.  We went site seeing on one of the back roads leading to Snow Summit and all ice!!  Definitely would stay here again.

name: Marley
text: House was perfect for our stay! Nice and clean and in a great location we really enjoyed it and would definitely stay there again. There was great communication that was really appreciated.

name: Josue
text: HELLO EVERYONE. Not much more to say other than this place ROCKS ! my family and I thoroughly enjoyed our stay there and we will definitely come back ! everything is as .... plenty of small treats laying around to help enjoy your stay there . Thank You Craig!

name: Lana
text: The house was amazing, very clean and cozy. The location was good, in walking distance to Zoo and trails. We slept a wonderful time. Very recommended. Host was very fast to respond. Thank you.

name: Celina
text: Thank you.

name: Marc
text: Ab&b has become a financial placement, fewer and fewer listings shared with Hosts are offered. Housekeeping is outsourced and it is often the customer who carries out the quality control because the owners do not live in the city of the rented accommodation, that's a shame. Craig's place is very nice and we recommend it.

name: Jacob
text: Awesome place

name: Italia
text: Thanks

name: Carly
text: Great location!

name: Erin
text: This place was great for our winter trip with a toddler. The only hiccup was that someone was parked in the driveway when we arrived which made it difficult for us to park after the recent 4ft snowfall. But we made it work. When I notified Craig, he made every effort to get the car towed. The owner eventually moved his car. Although it wasn't the fault of Craig by any means, his responsiveness was wonderful! The place was very clean and bright and so cozy! We especially loved all the cozy blankets to snuggle up with after a day out in the snow ❄️.  It was more than enough space for us 2 adults and a toddler with our pack n play. We will definitely stay again next time we're in Big Bear.

name: Nathan
text: I took my family (wife and 2 young kids) up to Big Bear for some snow play and Craig's place was the perfect spot. It's close to the ski resorts (which we didn't go to this time) and sledding spots (which we did). The house was beautiful and very cozy and homey. The bedrooms were big and there was plenty of room for the family to spread out. And the backyard, while compact, was perfect size for my kids to play around when it started to snow. And best of all, Craig was extremely responsive to any questions/messages (usually responded within a couple minutes) and even allowed us to check in a bit early when asked. We'd definitely come back to the house on our next trip!

name: Jesús Antonio
text: Loved it recommended 100%.

name: Karen
text: My 2nd time staying here. It’s so cozy and clean. The surrounding area is beautiful and soooo peaceful ♥️🐻🙏

name: David
text: The place was amazing. Peaceful location and easy check in. The owners were responsive and constantly were in communication with us.

name: Kelly
text: We originally booked this place the previous weekend but the host was so kind and proactive to allow us the option to cancel due to road closure circumstances. We decided to rebook the same place for this weekend based our experience with the host and it was such a lovely stay! So glad we came. The house was located on a quiet and beautiful tree lined neighborhood. My family and I decided to walk around the first day to check out the area and the locations described were very walkable ~ we walked to the cute Dank Donut shop and to the Alpine zoo with the kids while they got to snow play along the way. We enjoyed time at the resort with the kids during the day and enjoyed the evening at the house while roasting marshmallows in the cute fireplace. Absolutely a delightful mini weekend vacay and the hosts were very responsive and a delight to communicate with. Definitely would stay again for future 😀

name: Annie
text: Terrific place! Had everything we needed and then some. Awesome location. Easy walk to trail, Snow Summit and beautiful surroundings. Would def stay there again!

name: Jennifer
text: Craig’s Big Bear home was fantastic! It was clean, comfortable, and everything we needed for a wonderful weekend! We were a very short drive from several areas that had hills for sledding, a few minutes from Von’s/Stater Brothers, and less than ten minutes from the Big Bear Village. As a family of four, we had plenty of space. Bedrooms were spacious and beds were comfortable, with extra blankets and pillows available. My in-laws had planned to come with us but had to cancel; however, we still would’ve had plenty of space if they had been there. The living room had a huge comfortable sofa and chaise, and a table with two arm chairs. The kitchen was well stocked with dishes, silverware, pots, pans, spices and oil. There was too much snow for us to use the grill or fire pit, but the backyard was perfect for enjoying the snow! Craig was friendly and so responsive—I’d barely hit send and have a response immediately! We plan to return in the future!

name: Natalie
text: Great place to stay. Everything was nice and clean. Rooms are spacious, and beds are comfortable. Highly recommend.

name: Ali
text: Such a great place for a big bear getaway to stay! Craig messaged us frequently making sure we didn’t need anything or had any questions.

name: Annie
text: Really enjoyed our stay. Quiet neighborhood. Very responsive host. Super clean. Everything you could ask for in the house!

name: Kelsi
text: The house was clean, cozy and comfortable! It was really close to town as well. Craig kept in contact which was extremely appreciated!

name: Alejandra
text: Amazing place!! In a privileged location, easy access, with everything you need to spend wonderful days with your family!!

name: Rosaura
text: I'm traveling with my family, the place was very comfortable and spotless. A very peaceful place and with accurate instructions on how to use everything. I would stay there again

We loved it and we already count the minutes so we can come back next year…
